requirements.text: **Minimum Qualifications:** - Bachelor's Degree in data science, statistics, econometrics, math or a related scientific major, with 2+ years of related work experience. - Expertise in SQL and programming in Python or R. - Excellent analysis skills with good communication skills. - Strong logical and quantitative skills, with practical experience in recommendation systems. Preferred Qualifications: - Strong communication, teamwork skills, self-driven and self-learning ability. - Passionate about content products and curiosity to deep dive. - Experience in content products, content management tools, and creator management strategies. - Experience operating accounts on social media and content platforms.
